entries.title: Work Orders carried to the next day at Close Day: count them on the new day, or on their creation day?
entries.notes: TC-POS-071, 21/11, build 1.2.498: WO-182 created 20/11, Carry to Next Day at close. After Open Day 21/11 it counts as Total 1 / Pending 1 on 21/11 (WorkingDayID moved to the new day). Story says count by creation date.

entries.title: Completing a carried-over Work Order overwrites its WorkOrderDate and clears ShiftedFromWorkingDayID. Is losing the original creation date intended?

entries.title: MAC1 closes by itself after Confirm Payment on a carried-over Work Order
